run.question:
Alertmanager alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus since 2026-11-16T21:44:54Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert fires because Prometheus in namespace prometheus has no Alertmanager to discover: the loaded rule is max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1, and no Alertmanager workload, Service, Endpoints, pod or alertmanager container image exists anywhere in the cluster. The four prometheus-namespace stack components present are the operator, Prometheus, kube-state-metrics and node-exporter. Prometheus itself is up and ready with 0 restarts. Its StatefulSet was created 2026-11-15T22:30:54Z with generation 1 and identical current/update revisions, so no template rollout occurred, but its pod was recreated at 2026-11-16T21:44:22Z, 32 s before the alert's activeAt of 21:44:54Z; the reason for that recreation is not recoverable from the retained events (earliest event 21:52:14Z). No ResourceQuota or NetworkPolicy exists, and the alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com CRD and operator RBAC are present. Because the Alertmanager custom resource cannot be read with the available tools, operator and Prometheus container logs returned no data, prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered is absent from the metrics store, and change history is not integrated, the reason the Alertmanager component is absent (never installed vs. removed) and the exact time the condition began remain unverified; the Alertmanager object that should exist is therefore not named as root_cause.

claims.text: The Prometheus rule file loaded via ConfigMap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 defines alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers with expr max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1, i.e. it fires when Prometheus discovers fewer than one Alertmanager over a 5m window.

No Alertmanager StatefulSet exists: the cluster-wide StatefulSet list contains 6 objects (clickhouse chi-clickhouse-main-0-0, data-recorders jaeger-traces-recorder and prometheus-alert-recorder, kube-system topology-monitor, opensearch-cluster-master, prometheus prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus) and none is an Alertmanager.
No Alertmanager Deployment exists: the cluster-wide Deployment list has 36 objects and none is named alertmanager, and no Deployment's container images contain the string alertmanager.
No pod anywhere in the cluster has alertmanager in its name or namespace, and no pod runs a container image containing alertmanager (66 pods inspected).

No Alertmanager Service or Endpoints exists: the 5 Services and 5 Endpoints in namespace prometheus are prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, prometheus-kube-state-metrics, prometheus-operated and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter, and cluster-wide filtering of Services and Endpoints by name containing alertmanager returned none.

The Alertmanager machinery that would create such an object is installed: CRD alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com (group monitoring.coreos.com) exists, and ClusterRoleBinding prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator binds the operator service account to ClusterRole prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator.

Pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is Running, both of its container readiness values are true, its restart count is 0, and its startTime is 2026-11-16T21:44:22Z on node i-0bc0544469bfef13a; the same listing shows no Alertmanager pod in namespace prometheus.

StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus in namespace prometheus was created 2026-11-15T22:30:54Z, has generation 1 and observedGeneration 1, and its status.currentRevision equals status.updateRevision (prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-677d847d59), so its pod template was not changed before pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 was recreated at 21:44:22Z.
No ResourceQuota and no NetworkPolicy exists in the cluster, so neither a quota nor a network policy can be the reason an Alertmanager pod or the Prometheus-to-Alertmanager path is missing/blocked.
No event in the retained event set (21:52:14Z–22:25:00Z) involves an object whose name contains alertmanager, and there are no events at all for namespace prometheus in that set.

The rule-files ConfigMap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 in namespace prometheus was created 2026-11-16T21:38:00Z and contains the otel-demo alerting/recording rule files together with the kube-prometheus-stack prometheus rule file.

The metrics store used here does not carry Prometheus self-metrics: in 2026-11-16T21:30–22:34 it returned 63 metric names, and none of them is prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered or any other prometheus_* series.

The alert records in this environment are collected from a Prometheus server's HTTP API path {endpoint}/api/v1/alerts by the data-recorders configmap alerts-recorder-prometheus-scripts, not from an Alertmanager API.

The cause of the firing alert is the total absence of any Alertmanager instance in the cluster: Prometheus's alertmanager configuration/discovery yields zero targets, prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered stays below 1, and the loaded rule max_over_time(...[5m]) < 1 fires. The specific object that should exist cannot be named from evidence because the Alertmanager custom resource is not readable with the available tools and no Alertmanager object appears in any workload, Service, Endpoints, pod or image listing.

The alert's start time of 2026-11-16T21:44:54Z most plausibly reflects Prometheus in-memory alert state being reset by the pod recreation at 21:44:22Z (32 seconds earlier), because firing-alert records are read from the Prometheus /api/v1/alerts API; the underlying zero-Alertmanager condition may therefore predate the authorized window rather than having begun at 21:44:54Z.

The kube-prometheus-stack deployment in this cluster may have been installed without an Alertmanager component (no Alertmanager object is visible in any namespace) while the packaged PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule is still loaded from the prometheus rule file, which would make this alert a permanent condition of the deployment rather than a transient incident.

Prometheus itself is not down or degraded: pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is Running with both containers ready and restart count 0, so the alert is not explained by Prometheus being unavailable, crashing or restarting containers.
Rejected: a NetworkPolicy blocking traffic between Prometheus and Alertmanager. No NetworkPolicy objects exist in the cluster at all.

Rejected: a ResourceQuota in namespace prometheus preventing an Alertmanager pod from being created. No ResourceQuota exists in the cluster, and no Alertmanager StatefulSet exists either, so scheduling quota is not the limiting factor.

Rejected: the 21:44:22Z Prometheus pod replacement was a configuration rollout that removed alertmanagers from Prometheus. StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus has generation 1 and currentRevision equal to updateRevision, i.e. its pod template was never updated after creation on 2026-11-15T22:30:54Z.

Verify on the Prometheus custom resource in namespace prometheus whether spec.alerting.alertmanagers is populated and whether any alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com resource exists (e.g. kubectl -n prometheus get alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com, kubectl -n prometheus get prometheus prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus -o yaml), then either deploy/restore the Alertmanager instance and its governing Service so discovery yields at least one target, or, if alerts are intentionally not routed to an Alertmanager here, disable the PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule so it does not fire permanently.

Retrieve the kube-prometheus-stack operator logs and the Prometheus container logs from a working log pipeline (they returned no data in this Run) and check the Prometheus /api/v1/alertmanagers response plus the prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered series, to confirm the discovered count is 0 and whether the operator is failing to reconcile an existing Alertmanager resource.

gaps: The Alertmanager custom resource (alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com) cannot be read with the available Kubernetes tools, so it is unknown whether an Alertmanager resource exists, what its name/spec is, and whether the operator is expected to create an Alertmanager StatefulSet.

Logs were not obtainable: fetch_pod_logs for prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 and for the operator pod prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh returned status no_data with zero lines for all containers including the current instances, so operator reconcile errors and Prometheus alertmanager connection errors could not be checked.

Events are only retained from 2026-11-16T21:52:14Z to 22:25:00Z, so the reason pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 was recreated at 21:44:22Z is unknown, and whether an Alertmanager StatefulSet/Service existed and was deleted around that time cannot be established.

The alerting signal itself is unreadable here: prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered is not present in the metrics store (63 metric names returned for 21:30–22:34, none prometheus_*), so neither its current value nor when it began to deviate could be measured.

A query for kube_statefulset / kube_service / kube_pod_info metric names and for kube_statefulset_status_replicas series returned status no_data, so kube-state-metrics coverage of workload health could not be used and is unknown rather than showing replicas at zero.
A rule lookup for PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (list_prometheus_rules) returned status no_data, so the rule text in the rule-files ConfigMap was the only evidence of the alerting expression.
The change-history integration is not available, so no record of a Helm change, Alertmanager deletion or configuration edit around 2026-11-16T21:38–21:44Z could be reviewed.

Prometheus configuration lives in a Secret that cannot be read, so the alerting.alertmanagers section of the running Prometheus config (empty vs. pointing at a non-existent target) could not be inspected, and the credentials/endpoint used by the alert recorder could not be verified.
next_steps: Query the Prometheus custom resource prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus in namespace prometheus (spec.alerting.alertmanagers) and list alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com resources to confirm whether an Alertmanager is declared.

Read the kube-prometheus-stack operator (prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh) and prometheus container logs from a working log pipeline, and check Prometheus /api/v1/alertmanagers and prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered.

If Alertmanager is meant to be part of this deployment, restore the Alertmanager release and its governing Service in namespace prometheus; if not, disable the packaged PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule to stop the permanent warning.
Check cluster change history/Helm release metadata for a change to the kube-prometheus-stack or otel-demo monitoring configuration between 2026-11-16T21:38Z and 21:44Z.
